agentConfirmApply: Apply changes to the following files?
settingsWatchModeDesc: Watch the project folder for changes (enables the file watcher).
settingsIgnorePatternsDesc: Glob patterns excluded from indexing (like .codewikiignore entries).
settingsWarnThresholdHint: Enable "Impact Warnings" in the Behavior tab to apply these thresholds.
appDescription: AI-powered code knowledge base with ontology-based semantic model
insSubtitle: Health, graph query, evolution, incremental wiki & evaluation — running on the indexed ontology.
insNoProject: Open and index a project first to use Insights.
insHealthHint: A–F health grade from circular dependencies, dead code, coupling & God Objects — computed on the ontology graph.
insSecHint: Rule-based scan for hardcoded secrets, eval(), SQL/shell injection, unsafe HTML & debug statements.
insSecNoFs: File access unavailable (run in the desktop app to scan source).
insQueryPlaceholder: Ask in natural language, e.g. "who calls handleSearch" / "impact of getGraph" / "list all classes"
insQueryHint: Pattern-based NL → graph query (no LLM). Supports callers / callees / references / impact / deps / path / find.
insQueryNoResult: Could not understand the query. Try "who calls X", "impact of X", "list all classes".
insHistNoSnapshots: No snapshots yet. Capture one now, then re-index after code changes and capture again to see the architecture evolve.
insHistHint: Snapshots are kept for this session. Capture → change code → re-index → capture again.
insWikiPlaceholder: Changed file paths, one per line, e.g.\nsrc/services/code-agent.ts\nsrc/components/SearchPanel.tsx
insWikiHint: Given changed files, finds which wiki pages need regeneration (direct + transitive) instead of a full rebuild.
insWikiNone: No wiki pages are affected by these changes.
insWikiFull: All pages affected — a full regeneration is recommended.
insEvalPlaceholder: Ground-truth cases as JSON array (EvalCase[]). e.g.\n[{"name":"who calls foo","type":"callers","entity":"foo","expected_callers":["bar"]}]
insEvalBaselinePlaceholder: Optional baseline JSON (from a previous run) for regression detection.
insEvalHint: Grades retrieval/impact accuracy (precision / recall / F1) against ground-truth cases; optional baseline detects regressions.
insEvalError: Invalid JSON — expected an array of EvalCase objects.
topConfigureApiKey: Please configure your API key in Settings first.
welcomeSubtitle: Select a project folder to get started
welcomeDescription: An AI code knowledge base based on an ontology semantic model. Generate project documentation and knowledge graphs for precise code analysis and modification.
welcomeOpenLocalDesc: Select a local project folder to automatically analyze the code structure and generate wiki documentation.
errInvalidGithubUrl: Please enter a valid GitHub URL
wikiNoContent: No wiki content yet. Index a project to generate documentation.
wikiNoneDescAfter: in the top bar to create AI-powered documentation for your project. You can also configure your LLM provider in Settings.
graphNoData: No ontology data. Index a project first.
graphEmpty: No code entities found. Index a project to see the knowledge graph.
graph3dFallback: 3D rendering unavailable on this device (no WebGL / GPU) — showing the 2D graph instead.
chatEmptyDesc: Uses ontology-based semantic search and RAG to provide accurate, grounded answers about your code.
chatErrorSuffix: Check your API key in Settings.
agentHeaderDesc: Precise code modifications using ontology-based impact analysis. Prevents hallucination by verifying all changes against the code knowledge graph.
agentAutoFixTitleVerify: Analyze, apply, run verification, and auto-retry on failure
agentAutoFixTitlePlain: Analyze and apply automatically (enable Verification in Settings to add a test/build gate)
agentRollbackTitle: Restore all modified files to their state before applying
agentEmptyDesc: Describe the code change you want. The agent will analyze the ontology graph to identify all affected entities and propose precise modifications without hallucination.
agentSuggestion1: Add input validation to the main form handler
agentSuggestion2: Refactor the database query functions into a repository pattern
agentSuggestion3: Add error handling to all API endpoints
agentSuggestion4: Rename UserService to AccountService and update all references
entityNoRelationsForEntity: No relations found for this entity.
entityNoSourceBrowser: No source available in browser mode.
entitySourcePreviewElectron: Source preview works in Electron desktop app.
settingsContextWindowDesc: Max characters per file sent to LLM.
settingsAutoReindexDesc: Automatically rebuild index on file changes.
settingsImpactDepthDesc: BFS traversal depth for impact analysis.
settingsWarnEntitiesDesc: Warn when impact exceeds this many entities.
settingsWarnFilesDesc: Warn when impact spans more than this many files.
settingsExtractArrowDesc: Include arrow functions and React components.
settingsWikiStyleDesc: Choose the prompt style for wiki generation. Different styles produce different document structures and levels of detail.
settingsPageCountDesc: Target number of wiki pages to generate.
settingsIncludeMermaidDesc: Generate architecture/flow diagrams in the wiki.
settingsAutoGenerateDesc: Automatically generate the wiki after indexing.
settingsSnippetLengthDesc: Max characters shown per result snippet.
settingsSidebarPositionDesc: Which side to show the sidebar.
settingsShowLineNumbersDesc: Show line numbers in code view.
settingsWordWrapDesc: Wrap long lines in code view.
settingsConfirmApplyDesc: Show confirmation before applying code changes.
settingsRememberProjectDesc: Reopen the last project on startup.
settingsMaxRecentDesc: Number of recent projects to remember.
settingsUseIgnoreFileDesc: Respect a .codewikiignore file at the project root when indexing.
settingsExcludeSensitiveDesc: Apply built-in globs to skip .env, secrets, keys, and credential files.
settingsRedactSecretsDesc: Mask detected API keys/secrets in indexed content and search snippets.
settingsExtraPatternsDesc: Additional glob patterns to exclude (one per line).
settingsRender3DDesc: Render the knowledge graph in 3D (GitNexus-style) instead of 2D.
settingsNodeSizeDesc: Base size multiplier for graph nodes.
settingsShowLabelsDesc: Display entity name labels on graph nodes.
settingsRotationSpeedDesc: Auto-rotation speed of the 3D scene (0 disables auto-rotate).
settingsHybridSearchDesc: Combine TF-IDF with dense embeddings (RRF). Requires an OpenAI key or local Ollama; rebuild index after enabling.
settingsEmbedProviderDesc: Provider used to compute dense embeddings.
settingsEmbedModelDesc: Model name, e.g. text-embedding-3-small or nomic-embed-text.
settingsEmbedBaseUrlDesc: Override base URL for Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
settingsRrfKDesc: Reciprocal-rank-fusion constant; higher flattens rank weighting.
settingsVerifyEnableDesc: Let the Code Agent run project commands (lint/build/test) to verify edits.
settingsTimeoutDesc: Max seconds per command before it is killed.
settingsMcpEnableDesc: Expose CodeWiki tools to external clients (Claude, Cursor, VS Code) via MCP.
settingsMcpTransportDesc: stdio for editor integrations, http for networked clients.
settingsMcpPortDesc: Port used by the http transport.
settingsMcpProjectPathDesc: PROJECT_PATH passed to the server (defaults to the open project).
settingsMcpLogDirDesc: CODEWIKI_LOG_DIR where the MCP call log is written.
settingsMcpConsumerDesc: CODEWIKI_CONSUMER label reported in the call log.
settingsMcpToolsDesc: Tool names to expose, one per line. Leave empty to expose all tools.
settingsMcpDocsHint: See docs/MCP.md for full client configuration examples.
codeMapEmptyHint: Index a project to generate the code map.
codeMapSelectFile: Select a file to view details
codeMapArchDesc: Auto-generated from the ontology graph. Module dependencies, class hierarchy, and component interactions.
